tours.name: Delete a Departure Reason
tours.description: Learn how to delete a departure reason that was added by mistake. Reasons cannot be archived, only deleted.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to delete a departure reason that was added by mistake. Reasons cannot be archived, only deleted.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Departure reasons are managed in the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Departure reasons are managed in the Employees app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists used across the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists used across the Employees app.

steps.title: Departure Reasons
steps.description: These reasons are offered when an employee is archived. A reason that is already used on a departure cannot be deleted.

description_i18n.en_US: These reasons are offered when an employee is archived. A reason that is already used on a departure cannot be deleted.

steps.title: Find the departure reason
steps.content: Type the name of the departure reason and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name of the departure reason and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

steps.title: Select it
steps.content: Tick the box in front of the departure reason.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the box in front of the departure reason.

steps.description: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to delete them together.

description_i18n.en_US: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to delete them together.

steps.title: Actions
steps.description: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

steps.title: Delete
steps.description: Deleting removes the record for good. Odoo only allows it when nothing else uses the record; if it is in use, archive it instead where that is offered.

description_i18n.en_US: Deleting removes the record for good. Odoo only allows it when nothing else uses the record; if it is in use, archive it instead where that is offered.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.content: Click Delete in the window to confirm.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Delete in the window to confirm.

steps.description: Odoo asks once more because the change affects every ticked record.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo asks once more because the change affects every ticked record.
